elements.requirement: Section 235 of the Sentencing Act 2020 applies where a detention and training order is available.
elements.quote: This section applies where a detention and training order is available.

elements.requirement: The court may not make a detention and training order if it imposes a sentence of detention under section 250 in respect of the offence.
elements.quote: The court may not make a detention and training order if it imposes— (a) a sentence of detention under section 250

elements.requirement: The court may not make a detention and training order if it imposes an extended sentence of detention under section 254 in respect of the offence.
elements.quote: The court may not make a detention and training order if it imposes—

elements.requirement: If an offender is aged under 15 when convicted, the court may not make a detention and training order unless it is of the opinion that the offender is a persistent offender.
elements.quote: If the offender is aged under 15 when convicted the court may not make a detention and training order unless it is of the opinion that the offender is a persistent offender.

elements.requirement: The court's power to make a detention and training order is subject in particular to section 230 regarding the threshold for imposing a discretionary custodial sentence.
elements.quote: The court's power to make a detention and training order is subject to (in particular) section 230 (threshold for imposing discretionary custodial sentence).

thresholds.what: age of the offender when convicted below which a detention and training order requires the court to be of the opinion that the offender is a persistent offender
